purpose: One locally executed educational-analytics campaign with freshly trained models and one common measurement and uncertainty methodology

server.server_wide_memory: Record actual server setting; the 4 GiB limit is per query, not the total server memory allocation

environment: Modules run sequentially on one local host and ClickHouse lifecycle, using identical package versions and no concurrent experiment workers.
primary_statistic: Arithmetic means with equal weights for each fixed snapshot/session stratum; reduction = 100 * (1 - variant_mean / baseline_mean)

uncertainty.method: Paired circular moving-block bootstrap within each fixed snapshot/session stratum, preserving variant pairing; strata are not resampled
uncertainty.scope: Conditional measurement variability for these fixed data, tasks and hardware; not cross-institution generalization

repetition_and_integrity.order: Seeded randomized Williams designs balance variant position and pairwise precedence over measured rounds
repetition_and_integrity.warmups: Three warm-up rounds per session; retained and marked, excluded from primary estimates by design
repetition_and_integrity.gc: Enabled; explicit full collection before each paired group, outside variant timers
repetition_and_integrity.retention: Retain every completed valid paired group; no removal or replacement based on speed, effect direction, or confidence interval
repetition_and_integrity.technical_failures: Stop on failed correctness or execution checks; retain the incomplete attempt and reason separately; code changes require a new frozen attempt
repetition_and_integrity.persistence: Append and fsync each completed paired group before proceeding
repetition_and_integrity.timing: Monotonic high-resolution wall-clock; correctness checks and journal writes outside timers

selection.description: Fresh local fitting and calibration of declared temporal folds for all datasets, followed by native catalog-search comparison on MoocRadar: all 64 task-pairs versus 16 independently evaluated task configurations followed by union
selection.pipeline_timing_scope: Single-pass catalog-evaluation pipeline including 16 model fits, 9 aggregate materializations, 64 joint evaluations or 18 independent/reference/union evaluations, selection and retirement. It measures one search pass, not the full ten-pass operational calibration procedure; the latter separately supplies operational choices and models.
selection.split_integrity: Only training fits models; calibration selects representations; held-out labels are used only for quality reporting
selection.calibration_order: For the 64 MoocRadar candidates, five seeded random permutations and their reversals form ten measured calibration rounds, balancing every candidate pair's precedence 5/5. Candidate positions are not uniform across ten rounds. Five transfer candidates use a complete ten-row Williams design.
selection.quality_uncertainty: MoocRadar: 1000 paired learner-cluster bootstrap draws. ALPACAS: 2000 paired published USER_ID-cluster draws retaining every course participation of each sampled identifier. Moodle: 2000 paired outcome-stratified draws over unique participants. Published USER_ID clustering does not itself validate person linkage across source courses.
selection.operational_models: Export freshly fitted portable model parameters and calibration choices before operational measurements; derived outputs are hashed and retained
selection.maintenance_models: Also export freshly fitted d28_NS classifier and d28_N ranker for the separately declared certificate-compatible fixed maintenance workload

common.input_boundary: Canonical event window and common resident context prepared before timers; identical participant/query/candidate population for both variants
common.answer: One HTTP aggregate-bundle retrieval, task-input reconstruction, freshly fitted model inference, ranking where required, and exact monitoring
common.build: Materialize a new generation of all task aggregates, compact it, and retire the preceding owned generation
common.update: Rebuild from the declared changed canonical window, publish the aggregate bundle view, and retire the preceding generation
common.change: Remove canonical events with eid modulo 100 equal to zero; prepare and check changed common context outside timers
common.storage: Active native aggregate parts plus compact JSON model parameters and plan specifications; common canonical history/context excluded identically and reported separately

history.description: Physically replicate the complete canonical window and participation population, preserving per-replica tasks, context and correction mask

population.description: Deterministic nested served-population subsets from each fixed source snapshot. Canonical events and materialized aggregates are restricted to served participations; global course context remains fixed. Compare the four aggregate layouts with identical selected tasks within each subset.

maintenance.workload: Fixed 2020-11-30 held-out 235 requests, 541 correction records and 898933-event history at factor one
maintenance.boundary: Response includes three serving reads and necessary historical lookups; exact-state completion is reported separately; publication is excluded from response timing
maintenance.quality: Recompute direct updated-state oracle with the same freshly fitted models and check every policy against the required response contract
